headline: Dávid Vitézy makes huge announcement: hundreds of thousands of Hungarians may soon get housing, here is the government's plan
summary: Hungarian government plans, presented by Dávid Vitézy, aim to create affordable rental housing, student dormitories and liveable neighbourhoods. Practical implementation begins early next year.
why: Government housing programmes financed by EU funds and private capital affect construction activity and the rental market.
